sourceFile: 02. L20S15-07DT Report test  Material CD date 3.17 (Lot 510k)_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The workbook contains a valid comparable review of Lot CD 3.17 size 510k versus Normal, but the draft misstates the changed condition and omits key test-result rows from the main outcome grouping.
issues: Changed factor is incorrectly labeled as 'test/changed condition not explicit' even though the source identifies the changed condition as Lot CD test / CD 3.17 size 510k.
Primary outcome metric only includes Normal rows Report!23 and Report!27, omitting the corresponding Lot CD test rows Report!21 and Report!25.
Line-level subgroup context C2 and E2 should be preserved because results are reported separately by line before being summarized.
Outcome grouping should include separate VP/CD NG and function NG results from Report!21, Report!25, Report!41, and Report!42, not just dyne/tension inputs.
Tension outcome is generally comparable, but the spec from Tension!4 is not carried into the extracted measurement result.
Evidence rows for the changed factor should include Report!21 and Report!25 in addition to Normal and Tension rows.
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to 'Normal vs Lot CD test CD 3.17 size 510k' or equivalent.
Set baselineCondition to 'Normal' and changedCondition to 'Lot CD test / CD 3.17 size 510k'.
Add subgroupKeys for line, at minimum C2 and E2, because test and normal results are reported by line.
Revise the main result outcome to compare Report!21 against Report!23 for C2 and Report!25 against Report!27 for E2.
Include summarized result rows Report!39 through Report!42 as conclusion evidence for dyne, tension, VP/CD separation NG, and function NG.
For the tension outcome, retain Tension!8 versus Tension!10 and cite Tension!4 for the 1.2 kgf spec.
Keep all outcome domains under one review case because the workbook is one validation report for the same Lot CD 3.17 test condition.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Existing citations prove row existence, but final evidence is not sufficient until the omitted Lot CD test rows and summary result rows are added.
